primitives.name: Pinhole Camera Model
primitives.verbatim_quote: - **Camera model:** pinhole P=K·R·[I|-t]; square pixels, zero skew, principal point at image center; rotation R=R_z(roll)R_x(tilt)R_z(pan); intrinsics reduced to FoV (f_x^NDC=1/tan(0.5·FoV)); φ=(FoV,t,pan,tilt,roll); optional radial lens-distortion ψ={k1,k2} (kornia model), differentiable undistort enabling joint optimization.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'P': 'camera projection matrix (dimensionless)', 'K': 'intrinsics matrix (pixel)', 'R': 'rotation matrix (dimensionless)', 'I': 'identity matrix (dimensionless)', 't': 'translation vector (meter)', 'FoV': 'field of view (radian)', 'ψ': 'radial distortion coefficients (dimensionless)'}
primitives.assumptions: Square pixels, zero skew, principal point at image center, isotropic lens distortion.
primitives.breakdown_regime: High distortion or extreme FoV where linear approximations fail.

primitives.name: Multi-Initialization ArgMin Optimization
primitives.verbatim_quote: - **Optimization:** AdamW, lr 0.05, weight decay 0.01, 2000 steps, one-cycle schedule (pct_start=0.5); params standardized to zero mean / 95%-CI-scaled std from uniform camera-range priors; multiple initializations (center/left/right) with argmin-loss selection; self-verification: reject samples with loss > τ (τ=0.019 tuned on SN-Calib-valid-center, searched over [0.013,0.025]).
primitives.assumptions: Multiple random starts improve convergence to global minimum; loss threshold filters unreliable estimates.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Poorly initialized or highly non-convex loss landscape.

layer2.mapping: Improves robustness of calibration by selecting best estimate among several trials.
layer2.telemetry: Success rate of argmin-selected solutions vs. baseline single-init methods.

Segments such as lines and circles are annotated in 3D space and projected onto the image plane using the camera model. A loss function computes the average distance between these projections and their ground truth counterparts. This process is optimized using AdamW with multi-initialization strategies to avoid local minima. Lens distortion is modeled differently and jointly optimized for better accuracy. The approach leverages deep segmentation networks trained on a large dataset of match images to extract field elements. The system evaluates performance through IoU metrics and reprojection errors, indicating its suitability for precise geometric alignment tasks.
